normalization: Unicode NFKC/casefold, punctuation to spaces, whitespace collapse. No number/accent/script normalization. Mandarin CER includes Simplified/Traditional differences; its space-token WER is not meaningful.
draft_revision: Five-second draft aligned by edit distance to best final prefix, allowing appended final text. This is decoder revision, not measured user correction effort.
limitations: Only three short public read-speech cases per language, one artificial splice per long language; no population or conversational accuracy claim.

rejected_experiment.result: Long English WER 55.13% versus 64.74%, but long French worsened to 63.36% versus 40.09% and Mandarin CER to 54.51% versus 42.75%; omissions remained. No production decoder change retained.

stronger_model_probe.result: The earlier bounded run completed all 21 public probes, with exact repeats of the three long finals. A subsequent same-configuration run aborted on ar_eg-1 with native std::bad_alloc after 13 completed cases; see current_followup. Stability remains unqualified.
initial_failures: Default eager state plus verified weight buffer exceeded cap even on one short clip.
Unrealistic all-fixture preload exceeded cap after deferred state initialization.
Default five-candidate fallback exceeded cap and the upstream -7 error freed state, leaving a dangling pointer until the wrapper was corrected.
Reused fallback RNG/caches changed repeated French final output until state was reset per call.

loader_regression.before: Base worker exited abnormally during native loading with geometrically grown read buffer.
loader_regression.after: Exact receipt size plus one byte reserved before read; base loaded in 2053 ms and all 21 probes completed under unchanged 1 GiB limit. The independent signed-store fixture checks the production loader capacity.

hardware_followup.observation: Observed on 2026-10-06 in the same remote worktree/container after the public benchmark. Original timing receipt recorded x86_64 only; this is not contemporaneous CPU telemetry or proof of dedicated CPU availability.

current_followup.configuration: Same current two-thread, best_of=1, fresh-state CPU decoder and unchanged 1 GiB per-child address-space cap; each clip isolated in a non-root confined worker. Fixed language versus auto tested separately.

small_rerun.failure: Native std::bad_alloc, SIGABRT; the 21-case comparison did not complete. Failed phase was not instrumented in this original rerun.

isolated_followup.result: Completed draft, fixed-language final and auto-language final under the same cap after adding ABI exception handling and public phase diagnostics. This passing retry does not establish stability or reproduce the typed exception path.

small_rerun.qualification: Intermittent allocation failure unresolved. Preserve the previous completed receipt, but do not claim current Small stability or use this partial run as a complete comparison.

missing_case_followup.qualification: successful observations across the original aborted batch and a separate missing-case follow-up; not a successful 21-case batch or stability qualification

current_followup.model_selection: The existing signed installed-model service chooses the most recently installed valid SpeechRecognition model. Language is persisted independently in Settings. No new model preference, signing, installation or publication is included.
current_followup.limits: Decoder timings exclude cold loading, capture completion and editable-field ACK. No live microphone, older-device, Arm or end-to-end Flow-parity claim.

allocation_diagnosis.method: External parent samples /proc/<owned-child>/status every 20 ms. Each fresh non-root child retains production RLIMIT_AS, Landlock and seccomp. VmPeak/VmHWM are kernel high-water counters as observed; phase labels and final unobserved intervals have sampling uncertainty. No dump, ptrace, sandbox relaxation or real microphone.
allocation_diagnosis.inference: The qualified decoder approaches the virtual address-space limit despite about 500 MiB resident use. This supports address-space pressure as a cause of allocation failure, but does not identify the original failing native allocation or reproduce its exception path. Passing repeated cases do not establish complete Small stability.
allocation_diagnosis.decision: Retain qualified attention=false and allocator defaults. Arena/mmap controls do not provide robust headroom; Flash Attention trades memory for slower decoding and its interrupted partial batch lacks full accuracy qualification. No cap increase, promotion or new production tuning.

tiny_same_case_observation.limits: One resource observation only, not a complete memory-stability or older-device benchmark.

base.decision: No promotion: short Arabic WER 42.03%, Mandarin CER 33.33%, long English WER 64.74%; this small corpus does not establish Flow-level quality. Catalogue and user model selection unchanged.

memory_observation.method: External /proc sampling of each actual --single-case confined decoder, every 20 ms; clean LANG-only environment and UID/GID 65534. Initial all-case supervisor measurements discarded.
memory_observation.limits: Four independent public probes only; sampling is not a proof of worst-case allocation or older-device reliability.

document_start_composition.contract: Private document-start observer registration is acknowledged before navigation. Private text snapshots require its presence and idle state. Native trusted and synthetic composition are tracked separately; untrusted end events cannot clear trusted native composition. The retained initial iframe Window supplies the trusted native load boundary, which binds the current Document. Root removal retires its observer; document.open cannot reuse a surviving private marker. SDK composition refusals are confirmed no-edit receipts for Prepare, Start and Final.
